svg.title: Ten questions and what the tests answered
svg.desc: 1. Does a fresh review find real problems? Yes: on three real plans 20 issues were raised and all 20 accepted; Claude raised 18, Codex 6, both 4. 2. Which reviewer finds more of the flaws I planted? Tie: both found 18 of 18. 3. Which is faster and more reliable? Codex: 7.1 seconds and 24 of 24 usable replies, Claude 17.9 seconds and 21 of 24. 4. Which writes more extra valid issues? Depends on the grader: the Claude grader counted Claude 37 and Codex 17, and a Codex grader agreed on only 16 of 30. 5. Does a review beat a plain make it better? Tie: both fixed 24 of 24 planted flaws, and the rewrite made plans 3 to 4 times longer. 6. Second model or second read? A second read: two Claude reads found 19 valid issues, Codex plus Claude 17, two Codex reads 6, by the Claude grader. 7. Does planning give better code on small tasks? No: all 48 first builds passed and plan plus review used 15 times the tokens. 8. With facts left out, does planning help? Asking won: plain chat that cannot ask 2 of 12, chat that may ask 12 of 12, plan 11 of 12, reviewed plan 10 of 12. 9. Does the skill spot a high-stakes plan? Yes after a fix: the first rule scored 10 of 12, the reworded rule 16 of 16 with both models. 10. Did a person check the grading? Not yet: a blind sheet is ready.
svg.text: Tests run 2026-11-19 and 2026-11-20. Review findings were graded by AI; the coding tests were judged by hidden tests.

g.text: YES
Does a fresh review find real problems?
3 of my real plans: 20 issues raised, all 20 accepted.
Claude raised 18, Codex 6, both 4.
TIE
Which reviewer finds more of the flaws I planted?
Both found all 18 planted blockers.
The test was too easy to separate them.
CODEX
Which reviewer is faster and more reliable?
Codex: 7.1 s median, 24 of 24 usable replies.
Claude: 17.9 s median, 21 of 24.
DEPENDS ON THE GRADER
Which reviewer writes more extra valid issues?
Claude grader: Claude 37, Codex 17.
A Codex grader agreed on only 16 of 30 findings.
TIE
Does a review beat a plain “make it better”?
Both fixed all 24 flaws I planted.
The rewrite made plans 3 to 4 times longer.
A SECOND READ
What helps more: a second model or a second read?
Valid issues on 9 plans: two Claude reads 19,
Codex + Claude 17, two Codex reads 6 (Claude grader).
NO
Does planning give better code on small tasks?
All 48 first builds passed, plan or no plan.
Plan + review used 15 times the tokens of plain chat.
ASKING WON
With a fact left out, does planning help?
First builds passed: can’t ask 2/12, may ask 12/12,
plan 11/12, reviewed plan 10/12.
YES, AFTER A FIX
Does the skill spot a high-stakes plan?
First rule: 10 of 12, missed a forecast plan.
Reworded: 16 of 16 with both models (plans I labelled).
NOT YET
Did a person check the AI grading?
No. The two AI graders split on 14 of 30 findings.
A blind sheet for a person is ready in runs/regrade/.
